contracts_rationale: No API, CLI flag, exit-code or JSON-envelope change. The only new interface is one Python function on the existing charter.activation.api seam (code_producing_for), and the consumer change re-keys a pre-existing internal gate. The review-readiness refusal text, the #6715/#5939 error codes and every CLI surface are unchanged.
friendly_name: Enforce the implementation-commit review prerequisite from code_producing
purpose_context: This mission advances Enforce the implementation-commit review prerequisite from code_producing on issue-6328-code-producing-review-gate so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.
purpose_tldr: A custom code-producing mission type can no longer reach review with nothing implemented; the review-readiness prerequisite is keyed on the code_producing capability, not the software-dev family name.
